subject: GreenForge inference pilot — demo scheduling
messages:
From: Elena Ramirez <elena@greenforge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: GreenForge inference pilot — demo proposal

Vivek / Marissa,

Great to connect yesterday — thanks for the quick follow-up. We’d like to schedule a live demo of Redwood’s inference stack for the GreenForge ML and product teams to see concrete latency/cost numbers against our use case (real-time enrichment of lead records).

Proposed: Wednesday, Jul 14 at 10:00 AM PT — 45 minutes (demo + Q&A).
Agenda (high-level):
- Short intro (5 min)
- Demo: real-time enrichment pipeline & latency breakdown (20 min)
- Cost/quantization discussion (10 min)
- Next steps & trial scope (10 min)

I’m attaching a short brief on our current pipeline for context (GreenForge-inference-brief.pdf). Please confirm whether you can do Jul 14 or propose alternatives the week of Jul 6–10.

Also looping in Samir (VP Eng) — he may join or send a delegate.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ramirez
Head of Data Products, GreenForge
Elena.Ramirez@greenforge.com

Attachment: GreenForge-inference-brief.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Re: GreenForge inference pilot — demo proposal

Elena — thanks for the brief and the proposed time. Jul 14 at 10:00 AM PT works for our team; we’ll block 45 minutes.

A couple of quick asks so we tailor the session:
- Can you share any sample payload sizes / expected qps (ballpark)?
- Who from GreenForge will drive the purchase/PO side (Samir or someone on procurement)?

Marissa (cc) will demo; I’ll join for the cost and rollout section. I’ll also send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a placeholder Doc link for pre-read items.

If Jul 14 becomes problematic, we’re flexible the week after as well.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Vivek / Marissa — quick update from our side. We’ve had a shift in Q3 priorities: the exec team decided to push most new infra pilots to Q4 while the product org focuses on a major integration that needs all engineering bandwidth through end of August. On top of that, Samir and a few folks will be traveling Jul 12–28 for customer workshops, so Jul 14 won’t work.

Given that:
- Please cancel the Jul 14 slot on your calendar.
- We’d like to put the active demo on hold and revisit in early October.
- In the meantime, could you send a concise one-pager and a short recorded walkthrough we can share with stakeholders? Procurement has asked for rough pricing bands to include in their planning.

I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts earlier, but for now the project is deprioritized internally (not a no — just timing).

Thanks for understanding — not the best timing on our side.

Best,
Elena

Elena — thanks for the heads-up, and totally understand the timing constraints. I’ve canceled the Jul 14 meeting on our end.

Quick follow-ups: 
- Attached: GF-inference-onepager.pdf — short summary you can drop into your internal thread.
- Attached: redwood-demo-recording.mp4 (6min) — a short walkthrough that highlights latency/cost tradeoffs and our rollout pattern for a near-production pilot. You can share both with Samir and procurement.
- Pricing: for an initial pilot at the scale you described in the brief, rough guidance is $0.018–$0.035 per 1k tokens (depends on quantization/latency profile). I included three recommended pilot configurations in the one-pager.

If it helps, we’re happy to schedule a 20-minute sync in late September to prep materials ahead of an Oct touchpoint — saves time when you’re ready to re-open the pilot. I’ll follow up with a suggested cadence and a HubSpot task so we don’t lose momentum.

Thanks — and enjoy the workshops.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
